description: Chord check: identify, spell, key membership, transpose — Names a chord from its notes, spells a chord symbol into notes, tests whether a chord is diatonic to a key, or transposes a chord symbol, using pitch-class arithmetic over a fixed table of 21 chord qualities, for agents handling lead sheets and music metadata. Rule-based and labelled: when several readings are equally valid (C E G A is C6 or Am7/C) or no quality in the table matches, it returns un

chord.description: Chord symbol, root A-G with optional #/b, quality suffix, optional /bass: Cmaj7, F#m7b5, Bb/D.

expectChord.description: Optional claimed chord symbol to verify (identify, transpose).

expectNotes.description: Optional claimed notes in order, to verify (spell).

mode.description: Default major. minor is natural minor.

tonic.description: Key tonic, e.g. A or Eb.

items.description: Note name such as C, Eb, F#, Bbb, C##, optionally with octave (C4). Bass is the lowest note when every note has an octave, else the first.

prefer.description: Accidentals for a natural root when transposing. Default sharps; a root written with # or b keeps its kind.

name: chord-check
